---
title: "hdWGCNA module-focused plots"
format: html
---

针对单个模块的聚焦分析：Hub genes、ME 组间比较、GO/KEGG/Reactome 富集、Enrichr top terms 可视化。
改动 `target_module` 一处即可切换模块，所有变量名、标题、输出路径自动跟随。

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(hdWGCNA)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(tidytext)
library(statsExpressions)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ReactomePA)
library(enrichplot)

# ---- 单一真源：切模块只改这里 ----
target_module <- "M12"
org_db        <- org.Mm.eg.db
kegg_org      <- "mmu"
reactome_org  <- "mouse"

out_dir <- file.path("Results/hdwgcna", target_module)
# dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


## 1. Enrichr top terms 可视化

依赖：seurat_sub 已跑过 `RunEnrichr`，`enrich_target` 已从 `GetEnrichrTable` 过滤到 `target_module`。

```{r}
#| label: enrichr-plots

enrich_top <- enrich_target %>%
  group_by(db) %>%
  slice_min(P.value, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(P.value),
    Term_short = ifelse(
      nchar(Term) > 60,
      paste0(substr(Term, 1, 57), "..."),
      Term
    ),
    n_genes = lengths(strsplit(as.character(Genes), ";"))
  )

plot_title <- paste0(target_module, " Enrichr top 5 per database")

# 方案 A：分面条形图
p_bar <- enrich_top %>%
  mutate(Term_short = reorder_within(Term_short, neg_log10_p, db)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = neg_log10_p, y = Term_short, fill = db)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  facet_wrap(~ db, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = plot_title, x = expression(-log[10] ~ italic(P)), y = NULL) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# 方案 B：点图（大小=命中基因数，颜色=-log10 p）
p_dot <- enrich_top %>%
  mutate(Term_short = reorder_within(Term_short, neg_log10_p, db)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = neg_log10_p, y = Term_short,
             size = n_genes, color = neg_log10_p)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#4DBBD5", high = "#E64B35") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6)) +
  facet_wrap(~ db, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x = expression(-log[10] ~ italic(P)),
    y = NULL,
    size = "Gene count",
    color = expression(-log[10] ~ italic(P))
  ) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_bar)
print(p_dot)
```


## 2. Hub genes (top kME)

```{r}
#| label: hub-genes

kME_col <- paste0("kME_", target_module)

module_genes <- GetModules(seurat_sub) %>%
  filter(module == target_module) %>%
  arrange(desc(!!sym(kME_col)))

hub_top20 <- module_genes %>% head(20)
print(hub_top20[, c("gene_name", "module", kME_col)])
```

## 3. Module Eigengene 组间比较

Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn 两两比较（BH 校正），手动在 violin+boxplot 上标注 p 值。

```{r}
#| label: me-boxplot

hMEs <- GetMEs(seurat_sub, harmonized = TRUE)
me_df <- data.frame(
  cell  = rownames(hMEs),
  ME    = hMEs[, target_module],
  group = seurat_sub$group
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ME)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Normal", "Model", "QR056251")))

kw_res <- oneway_anova(data = me_df, x = group, y = ME, type = "nonparametric")
pw_res <- pairwise_comparisons(
  data = me_df, x = group, y = ME,
  type = "nonparametric", p.adjust.method = "BH"
)
print(kw_res)
print(pw_res)

kw_label <- sprintf(
  "Kruskal-Wallis: chi2 = %.2f, p = %.2e",
  kw_res$statistic, kw_res$p.value
)

p_box <- ggplot(me_df, aes(x = group, y = ME, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    Normal = "#4DBBD5", Model = "#E64B35", QR056251 = "#00A087"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(target_module, " Module Eigengene across groups"),
    subtitle = kw_label,
    x = NULL, y = "Harmonized ME"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 两两 p 值
y_max  <- max(me_df$ME, na.rm = TRUE)
y_step <- diff(range(me_df$ME, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.08
pw_res <- pw_res %>% mutate(y_pos = y_max + y_step * seq_len(n()))
grp_levels <- levels(me_df$group)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pw_res))) {
  x1 <- match(pw_res$group1[i], grp_levels)
  x2 <- match(pw_res$group2[i], grp_levels)
  p_box <- p_box +
    annotate("segment",
             x = x1, xend = x2,
             y = pw_res$y_pos[i], yend = pw_res$y_pos[i]) +
    annotate("text",
             x = (x1 + x2) / 2,
             y = pw_res$y_pos[i] + y_step * 0.3,
             label = sprintf("p = %.2g", pw_res$p.value[i]),
             size = 3.5)
}

print(p_box)
# ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(target_module, "_ME_boxplot_by_group.pdf")),
#        p_box, width = 5.5, height = 5)
```


## 4. 功能富集：GO BP / KEGG / Reactome (mouse)

```{r}
#| label: enrichment

entrez_tbl <- bitr(
  module_genes$gene_name,
  fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org_db
) %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all = TRUE)

ego_bp <- enrichGO(
  gene = entrez_tbl$ENTREZID, OrgDb = org_db, keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2, readable = TRUE
)

ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = entrez_tbl$ENTREZID, organism = kegg_org,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)
if (!is.null(ekegg) && nrow(ekegg) > 0) {
  ekegg <- setReadable(ekegg, OrgDb = org_db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
}

ereac <- enrichPathway(
  gene = entrez_tbl$ENTREZID, organism = reactome_org,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, readable = TRUE
)

# 统一画图（结果为空时返回 NULL，避免报错）
safe_dotplot <- function(x, title, show = 15) {
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
  dotplot(x, showCategory = show) + ggtitle(title)
}

p_go   <- safe_dotplot(ego_bp, paste0(target_module, " GO BP"))
p_kegg <- safe_dotplot(ekegg,  paste0(target_module, " KEGG"))
p_reac <- safe_dotplot(ereac,  paste0(target_module, " Reactome"))

print(p_go)
print(p_kegg)
print(p_reac)
```
